exceptions.decision: Favorites stay in useState and clear on refresh
exceptions.reason: OFFICIAL_README says localStorage is out of scope and persistence is not evaluated. The official brief outranks SIGNAL.
exceptions.evidence: src/components/AppShell.tsx and the favorites page copy

exceptions.decision: Catalog card titles use the h3 size, 1.5rem / 1.25
exceptions.reason: Card titles are repeated entity names in a grid. The page h2 scale would overflow the cards. Page headings still use the h2 token.

exceptions.rule: Full public-landing SEO: canonical, sitemap, schema, OG image
exceptions.decision: Title, description, language, and basic Open Graph text only
exceptions.reason: No production domain is confirmed. Prices and ratings are generated exercise data, so Offer or review schema would invent facts.

exceptions.rule: Idle, loading, success, empty, error for every data request
exceptions.decision: No fake loading percentage. Loading copy exists for route Suspense. Empty and not-found are real. There is no network request to fail.
exceptions.reason: The catalog is a local module. A simulated progress bar would be a false state.

exceptions.rule: Three highlighted cards on the home page
exceptions.reason: Ratings are generated dataset fields, not live popularity. Three identical cards and a claim that people keep coming back were generic and untrue.
